press_references.value: TPConnects unveils industry-first MCP layer for Astra NDC Gateway, enabling AI-ready airline retailing at scale

product_launches.description: TPConnects Technologies launched two new components of its Astra NDC airline retailing platform—the Astra MCP Layer, an AI-ready orchestration layer that normalizes fragmented NDC schemas, and Astra ConvertEngine, an intelligent search optimization engine that reduces search volumes while maintaining accuracy.

overview_description.description: TPConnects is a Dubai-based travel technology company specializing in airline retailing, NDC distribution, and content aggregation solutions. Founded in 2012, it provides SaaS platforms like Astra for airlines and Iris for travel sellers, helping streamline bookings, distribution, and personalized travel offers. TPConnects is IATA-certified and partners with airlines, travel agencies, and global distribution systems to modernize travel commerce through AI-ready retailing technologies.

product.name: Iris
product.description: A travel seller aggregation platform that combines NDC, low-cost carrier, GDS, consolidator, and other air content for shopping, booking, servicing, pricing, and distribution.

product.name: Trip Captain
product.description: A conversational AI capability for travel planning and booking workflows, using natural-language interaction to manage offers, travel queries, and booking changes.
